name: Reizen Sae
source:
A bold girl who only wants to help… by ruling with an iron fist!

Sae is outwardly stern, with no patience for those who attempt to skirt the rules. Her ideals make her a uniquely unpopular candidate, so just what is driving her to take on the role of student council president?
